# C03 checkpoint fixture

Generated with the unmodified `qssd_space demo` from commit
`9e94cf59eefdd24e403e8fecb9677788ca76b876`, using the original cores in
`dependencies.json`. The binary XQSSD1 checkpoint is base64 encoded.

Size: 3995 bytes.

SHA-256: `2436ad91fdcf5436d2d5385c2503b047a6c855834f0e0e6edc76acf31973db66`.

The CLI test restores this pre-C04 state, checks the three shared ports and
continues XI before exporting a native RVPC2 state.
